name: TYTAN Technologies
what: AI-guided interceptor drones and counter-drone systems (Munich, TUM spin-out).
homonym_note: Not Tytan Tiles (magnetic toys) or other 'Tytan' names in Google News.

membership.basis: Register: Visionaries Club Seed Fund II is named on TYTAN Technologies GmbH's shareholder list of 2025-08-06; press on the Feb 2026 Series A names Visionaries Club as a previous backer.
membership.quote: with previous backers Visionaries Club, OTB Ventures, Lakestar

entry.quote: Tytan had last raised funding in August 2025, but never disclosed the amount

funding_rounds.round: Unnamed (disclosed later as EUR 16M); register capital increase to EUR 51,504 on 2025-08-08

valuation.note: Two press figures for the Feb 2026 Series A disagree: Resilience Media 'sources tell us the round values Tytan just over EUR 150 million' and heise 'valued at 100 million euros in the Series A financing round' (https://www.heise.de/en/news/German-drone-defense-startup-raises-30-million-euros-11189328.html). Neither is company-stated; both are below USD 1B. Left empty for the judge.

graduation.quote: The round was co-led by Armira and the NATO Innovation Fund

notes: Entry: the Seed Fund II mention on the 2025-08-06 shareholder list matches the 2025-08-08 capital increase, i.e. the August 2025 round that Tytan only disclosed in Feb 2026 as EUR 16M (Resilience: 'Now it has confirmed it was EUR 16 million'). No source names that round; it preceded the Series A, so it is seed-stage in practice. If the judge rules it Seed, graduation = the EUR 30M Series A of 2026-02-24 (co-led by Armira and NATO Innovation Fund, Visionaries participating). Seed Fund II's register page shows no Tytan mention on the June 2024 list, and Tomorrow Fund I's only 2024 shareholding is Proxima Fusion, so Visionaries was most likely not in the 2024 round. Register: TYTAN Technologies GmbH, Munich HRB 287624, registered 2023-09-26; capital increases 2026-03-04 (EUR 65,808) and 2026-04-15 (EUR 69,259) follow the Series A. Total raised EUR 46M. Website left empty (not verified).
